full_prompt_en: A square Pre-Raphaelite-style painting shows a close row of pale profiles overlapping against a richly patterned gold ground. The image is cropped tightly at the sides, cutting off parts of the outermost faces and leaving almost no open space. At the center, a young woman with vivid copper hair faces left. Her hair is smoothly gathered into a large rounded coil behind the ear, with fine strands drawn across the top. A long pale neck rises from a dark garment with a high black collar and narrow brown-red trim. Her nose, lips, and softly blushed cheek are delineated with careful, clean contour; her gaze stays level toward the left. Immediately behind her on the left, a darker-haired figure also faces left, the black curls framing a profile above a white standing collar and red patterned clothing. A further partial face and warm-colored garment appear at the far left edge. On the right, another pale face enters in profile facing the same direction, with only the front of the hair, eye, cheek, and red garment visible before the crop. The figures form an almost continuous chain of noses, mouths, cheeks, and hair masses. Behind them, small gold panels, red and blue shapes, floral fragments, and thin dark lines fill the remaining gaps. The decorative background has shallow depth and a tapestry-like surface, while the skin remains smoother and more luminous. Soft even light falls from the front left, giving the pale faces gentle volume without hard shadow. Fine brushwork defines hair and ornament, and saturated auburn, black, cream, and warm gold remain carefully balanced. The overall composition is formal and rhythmic, using repeated profiles and packed ornament to create a still, ceremonial procession.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形拉斐尔前派风格绘画呈现一列紧靠的浅色侧面人物，彼此遮叠，背后是纹饰丰厚的金色底面。画面两侧裁切很紧，切掉最外侧面孔的一部分，几乎没有空白。中央，一名铜红发年轻女子朝左。头发平滑地拢在耳后，盘成大的圆卷，顶部绘有细发丝。修长浅色脖颈从深衣中升起，衣服有高黑领和窄棕红饰边。鼻、唇与轻红面颊以谨慎干净的轮廓刻画，目光平向左侧。她左后方紧挨着另一名深发人物，同样朝左，黑卷发围着侧面，下面是直立白领和红色花纹衣服。最左边还露出另一张局部面孔和暖色衣料。右侧，另一张浅色侧脸沿相同方向进入，画边只留下前方头发、眼、脸颊与红衣。人物连成一串几乎连续的鼻、嘴、脸颊和发团。其后，小金色面板、红蓝形状、花卉碎片与细深线填满余隙。装饰背景的深度很浅，表面如挂毯，皮肤则更平滑发亮。柔和均匀的光从左前方落下，给浅色脸部轻微体积，不产生硬影。细笔触定义发丝和纹饰，浓赤褐、黑、奶油色与暖金色仔细平衡。整体构图正式而有节奏，以重复的侧面和密实纹饰营造静止的仪式队列。
style_prompt_en: The painted surface joins immaculate contour drawing to dense, jewel-toned ornament. Warm gold, copper, deep red, ink-black, and small blue-green notes repeat through closely packed shapes, creating unity without an empty background. Long smooth curves and rounded masses overlap in shallow space; repeated directional edges establish a measured procession-like rhythm. Pale smooth passages stand out against stippled and intricately patterned areas, so material contrast replaces strong shadow as the main separator. Fine hairline marks, narrow borders, and minute floral fragments enrich the surface while keeping large silhouettes clear. Lighting is soft and frontal, with modest modeling and almost no cast shadow. Edge control remains precise at the focal forms and more intricate in the surrounding ornament. The overall effect is formal, luminous, and richly decorative.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画表面把无瑕的轮廓线描与密实宝石色纹饰结合。暖金、铜色、深红、墨黑与少量蓝绿在紧密排列的形态间重复，让没有空背景的画面保持统一。修长平滑曲线和圆润团块在浅空间里遮叠；反复朝向的边缘建立有节制的队列节奏。浅色平滑段落从点状和繁密纹饰区域中站出，材质反差取代强阴影成为主要分隔手段。细发丝般的笔迹、窄饰边和微小花卉碎片丰富表面，同时保持大剪影清楚。照明柔和而正面，塑形适度，几乎没有投影。焦点形态的边缘控制精确，周围纹饰则更复杂。整体效果正式、发亮且装饰丰厚。
theme_en: A row of closely overlapping profiles against a patterned gold ground
theme_zh: 金色纹饰背景前一列紧密重叠的侧面人物
name: John Roddam Spencer Stanhope
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
